turns.teacherReply: Hi Anaya, I’m Arjun, your AI teacher. Today we’ll explore physical and chemical changes. Which music instrument or song do you enjoy?

ask.text: Which music instrument or song do you enjoy?

turns.teacherReply: A drumbeat can change from soft to loud, but the drum may stay the same. At the end, you’ll teach this idea to Bittu, who missed class. What do you think changed?

move.shape: open with one concrete everyday situation built on their interest (music) — kit contexts: kitchen, festival sweets, monsoon; ask what they think will happen or which they would pick — a prediction, no right answer yet; any bigger/more comparison: two quantities of one kind, in one unit — a count against a count, a distance against a distance; never across kinds; mention once: at the end they will teach this to Bittu (a pretend new student who missed this class)

guard.firstDraft: Hello Anaya! Imagine a drumbeat changing from soft to loud—what changes: the drum itself, or only the sound? Your prediction?

turns.teacherReply: A physical change alters shape, size, or state; no new substance forms. Melting ghee and dissolving sugar are examples. Which screen example is physical?

move.shape: one idea only: Define a physical change (no new substance; only shape, size or state changes) and give examples; an example from their interest (music) if it fits naturally; objects first, then the symbol; point at the screen only at what the on-screen row lists; never a drawing made of characters; end with one small question that makes them USE the idea — never 'samjha?'
